# Template Sync B — Update live docs

Follow the `adt-template-sync` skill: [`docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-template-sync/SKILL.md`](skills/adt-template-sync/SKILL.md). Do not reconstruct the procedure from memory.

6. If `CHANGELOG.md` is missing: fall back to comparing **content-template paths only** (`Feature_*_Template.md`, `Tooling_Template.md`, `Human_TODO_Template.md`, `Product_Vision_Template.md`, `Decision_Template.md`) against a prior pack copy. Never open all live feature docs "just in case."
- When **from** < 2.10.1 and **to** >= 2.10.1, **B0.6** offers to delete feature and shared `*-TODO.md` files. The offer is that step. Do not delete them in the offer. `auto` and `auto-all` are not a yes.
- If the union includes any of `content-templates`, `optional-live-reshape`, or `optional-assumption-cleanout`, run those steps even when newer selected entries also list `process-docs-only` (`process-docs-only` on one release does not cancel live passes from skipped releases).
**Default when `content-templates`, `optional-live-reshape`, and `optional-assumption-cleanout` are absent from the union:** bump versions + Master Index structure if tagged -> rules if tagged -> summarize -> **present unset options** (below). **Do not** open live `features/` or `_shared/` docs. **B0.6** may list `*-TODO.md` filenames under those two folders without opening them, and only when **from** < 2.10.1 and **to** >= 2.10.1.
3. Else -> create `ADT-settings.yaml` from the example when first recording a tool/optional/sync decision (do not invent installs). Do **not** copy a `standing:` key from the example - omit it unless the user already stated a playbook override.
| **`auto`** | Apply all changelog-gated live work without mid-sync optionals quiz: versions, master-index, content-templates (missing only), **optional-live-reshape** / **optional-assumption-cleanout** (all Document Map Understanding stems when tagged), rules refresh, upstream stamp. Still **ask once** for brand-new unset `optional_rules.*`. Summarize at end. |
| **`choose`** | Present reshape / assumption clean-out (and similar future optional live tags) each sync - ask once per tagged pass. |
3. **Content templates** *(if `content-templates`)* - Add **missing** sections/structure from local templates into live Understanding / Spec / Tooling / Human-TODO / Product-Vision. Do **not** remove or reshape existing sections here. Do not create or edit `*-TODO.md` in this step. Create `Tooling.md` / `Human-TODO.md` from templates when missing and link from Master Index. Create `Product-Vision.md` from the template if missing (**all** profiles, including `build-first`). **Peek `docs/reference/` first** (list files; prefer the newest idea/identity sources, or user-pointed files; skip vendor and API dumps unless they define the product - Workflow Section 4.5 Draft source). Draft is / is not + end-state picture from **those** + this-turn conversation (lock obvious; examples is not target unless clearly set; lightweight). **Then** fill How the map fits from existing map rows only. **Do not** build the picture by summarizing the Document Map / feature Understandings / specs. **Do not** skip `reference/` because the map looks complete. **`build-first`:** create if missing; **not a gate**; a `draft` vision is the destination.
- Scan every live Understanding / Spec unless `content-templates` or (`optional-live-reshape` and executing) or (`optional-assumption-cleanout` and executing) or the **2.7.25 standing relocate** one-shot (then only the **one** destination a misplaced standing bullet names - Workflow Section 0.2 Sync relocate) or the **2.7.27 instruction-footer strip** (then every in-scope stem's spec, and Understanding when present - including stems with no Understanding) or **B0.6** (list `*-TODO.md` paths under `docs/features/` and `docs/_shared/` only - do not open them - and only when **from** < 2.10.1 and **to** >= 2.10.1)
- Under **`choose`:** omit the reshape / assumption clean-out ask when those tags are present
- Under **`auto` / `auto-all`:** re-ask for reshape / assumption clean-out / rules refresh when tags say to run them
- Open Workflow, help guides, or the whole pack catalog during sync (open Workflow Section 4 only while executing reshape or assumption clean-out; Workflow Section 0.2 Sync relocate only when the 2.7.25 standing-relocate one-shot is in catch-up)
